summary: EVERTEC, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 4, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 results and announcing a Board-approved increase to its share repurchase authorization. The authorization was raised to permit up to an aggregate $150 million in future repurchases, with approximately $83 million previously remaining. The program allows open-market buys, accelerated share repurchases, Rule 10b5-1 plans, or privately negotiated transactions, expiring December 31, 2027. The company also raised its full-year 2026 outlook and signed strategic agreements with Transbank and Clip. This is a capital return event; watch for repurchase cadence and balance-sheet impact.
